title: ThreadsIPadView
description: Create AggregatorApp/iPad/Threads/ThreadsIPadView.swift. Landscape: content column shows thread list — reuse existing ThreadsViewModel and ThreadRowView if the audit confirmed reusability; selection sets iPadNavigationModel.selectedThread; detail column renders ThreadDetailView / ArticleDetailView driven by selectedThread. Portrait: thread list in the detail column; tapping pushes thread detail within the detail column's implicit NavigationStack. Handle Empty, Loading, and Error states explicitly.
acceptance_criteria: Landscape: thread list in content column, detail view in detail column driven by selection
Portrait: thread list in detail column, tap pushes thread detail
Empty, Loading, and Error states are explicitly rendered
Existing Threads views are not modified
Reuses ThreadsViewModel without modification if audit confirmed reusable
